en.shortDescription: Modern customizable dashboard for your homelab services
en.longDescription:
Homarr is a modern self-hosted dashboard to organize and launch your services.

Customize pages, add integrations, and centralize links to your internal apps.

de.shortDescription: Modernes anpassbares Dashboard für deine Homelab-Dienste
de.longDescription:
Homarr ist ein modernes Self-Hosted-Dashboard zum Organisieren und Starten deiner Dienste.

Passe Seiten an, füge Integrationen hinzu und zentralisiere Links zu deinen internen Apps.

fr.shortDescription: Tableau de bord moderne personnalisable pour vos services homelab
fr.longDescription:
Homarr est un tableau de bord auto-hébergé moderne pour organiser et lancer vos services.

Personnalisez les pages, ajoutez des intégrations et centralisez les liens vers vos applications internes.

pt.shortDescription: Dashboard moderno e personalizável para seus serviços homelab
pt.longDescription:
Homarr é um dashboard auto-hospedado moderno para organizar e lançar seus serviços.

Personalize páginas, adicione integrações e centralize links para seus aplicativos internos.
